clauses.text: Agreement A covers emergency maintenance at USD 400 per month through September 30, 2026. Service after that date requires separately signed Schedule S.
Agreement B begins October 1, 2026 and covers equipment rental, but makes no determination about emergency maintenance charges.
For October emergency maintenance, either a USD 400 continuation rate or a USD 550 replacement rate may apply according to signed Schedule S. Signed Schedule S has not been provided.
